title: Briefing Strips: Compact per-model & per-route telemetry cards
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Goal: Design a compact, scannable ‘briefing strip’ UI component for the Redwood Console that surfaces per-model and per-route performance signals (latency P50/P95/P99, throughput RPS, token counts, cost per token, error rate) in a single horizontal card suitable for dashboards, rollout modals, and email/print summaries.

Scope: Produce a high-fidelity Figma prototype with responsive variants for narrow ‘mini’ strips and wide ‘expanded’ strips; define chart specs for small multiples used inside the strips; author copy and accessibility guidance; collect engineering constraints for embedding in the Console. Target consumers are SREs, ML platform engineers, and PMs scanning performance regressions during rollouts.

Constraints & considerations: 1) Strong emphasis on density without sacrificing interpretability: charts must be legible at 160px height. 2) Color system must align with existing Console palette and be colorblind-safe. 3) Data shape: series are bursty (token spikes, tail latency), so sparklines need min/max bands and a small-sample-friendly smoothing toggle. 4) Interactivity: hover tooltip, click-to-expand, and lightweight drill path to route detail. 5) Exportability: printable summaries for postmortem reports.

Deliverables: Figma prototype (mini/compact/expanded variants), a spec sheet listing chart types and data inputs, accessibility notes, engineering handoff document including suggested CSS tokens and SVG export recommendations, and a small usability script for 5 quick user tests.
chart_specs: Latency sparkline: 3 quantile lines (P50 solid, P95 dashed, P99 dotted), min/max shaded band, Y-axis auto-scaled to 99th percentile, width: 220px (expanded) / 120px (mini), height: 48px.

Throughput RPS sparkline: single area chart with adaptive smoothing, overlay 1-minute rolling average, discrete point markers for detected bursts, recommended resolution: 1s or 5s depending on route traffic.

Token flow microbar: stacked microbar showing input vs. generated tokens per request aggregated to time buckets (default 1m), tooltip shows median and 95th percentile token count, color: input=blue, output=teal.
Cost-per-token gauge (compact): tiny numeric with trend chevron (up/down) and sparkline inset; for expanded variant show histogram of cost-per-request across last 24h.
Error-rate indicator: small donut with percent label plus time-series mini-sparkline below; thresholds configurable by route (default: warning 1%, critical 3%).
decisions: Use a horizontal strip layout to support dense scanning in route lists and dashboard rows.
Mini variant will show only P95 latency sparkline, RPS sparkline, token microbar, and error badge; Expanded variant shows P50/P95/P99 overlays and cost histogram.
Adopt current Console color tokens with an added semantic overlay palette for regressions (muted orange for warning, deep red for critical, neutral gray for stable).
Accessibility: ensure charts meet AA contrast and provide text-only fallback rows for export/print.
Engineering constraint: prototype will avoid custom WebGL; use SVG + CSS animations to keep bundle size predictable for Console.
